summary: Specifies an experimental ICMPv6 message type for the Identifier-Locator Network Protocol (ILNP). The message dynamically updates identifier and locator bindings for an existing ILNP session. It comes from the IRTF Routing Research Group.

eli5.summary: If you move to a new house, you send a note to your pen pal with your new address. This message does that for a computer during a conversation. It is only an experiment.
